items.question: Do I need an Apple Watch?
items.answer: No, it works perfectly on iPhone. However, Apple Watch adds heart rate monitoring and haptic guides for a better experience.

items.question: Is Wim Hof breathing safe?
items.answer: Generally safe for healthy people. Never practice in water or while driving. Consult a doctor if you have heart conditions.

items.question: How often should I practice?
items.answer: Start with once a day. Wim Hof is best for mornings, while 4-7-8 is great for sleep or high stress moments.

items.question: Can I use it offline?
items.answer: Yes! Once downloaded, Breathwave works 100% offline on both iPhone and Apple Watch.

items.question: How do I enable HealthKit synchronization?
items.answer: When you start your first session, the app will request permission to access health data. You can also manage permissions at any time via iPhone Settings > Health > Data Access & Devices.

items.question: Can I customize the breathing intervals?
items.answer: Absolutely! In specific breathing modes, you can go to settings to manually adjust the durations for inhale, hold, and exhale to match your lung capacity for a truly personalized practice.
